definitions.explanation: Describes a path, road, or shape that has many curves and turns.

examples.japanese: くねくね⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧。
くねくね⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: We climbed up the winding mountain road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くねくね⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くねくね⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいく→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧くねくね⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{踊|おど}っていた→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
examples.english: She was dancing with sinuous movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くねくね⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かしていた→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: The insect was wiggling its body.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
・くねくね(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧) - adverbially
・くねくね⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun - adjective form
・くねくね⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - verb form (to wind/wiggle)

TYPE:
Mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) - describes shape or movement rather than sound.

USAGE:
・⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くねくね⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (the road is winding)
・くねくね⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (to wind and turn)
・くねくね⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to move sinuously)

RELATED ONOMATOPOEIA:
・⟦うねうね→うねうね：noentry⟧ - undulating, wavy (larger scale than くねくね)
・⟦にょろにょろ→にょろにょろ：noentry⟧ - slithering (specifically snake-like creatures)
・⟦くにゃくにゃ→くにゃくにゃ：noentry⟧ - soft and flexible, floppy

NUANCE:
くねくね emphasizes repeated curves or undulating movement. Can describe roads, body movements, drawings, or anything with a sinuous quality.
